summary: Londax Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a change in control on July 13, 2026, where Alpha Investment Inc. acquired 2,002,035 shares (approximately 90% of outstanding common stock) from the former sole officer/director and minority shareholders. The aggregate purchase price was paid entirely in cash via installments from March 9 to July 13, 2026. Terms such as price per share, premium, and board recommendation are not disclosed; no advisors are named. The transaction closed with Alpha gaining control and appointing new management. This is a completed change-of-control event rather than an ongoing special situation; it does not fit as an acquisition since the registrant is the target and the filing is a post-closing report. Watch for integration updates or further regulatory filings.
